host.description: Hostname or IP address the ECFlow server binds to for client connections.

port.description: TCP port number used by the ECFlow server for client communication.

auth_mode.description: Authentication method for clients. Use 'password' for username/password or 'none' for no auth (not recommended for production).

data_dir.description: Directory where the server stores persistent state (suites, logs, recovery data). Must be writable by the service user.

log_dir.description: Directory for server log files, including activity and error logs.

max_clients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

shutdown_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for graceful shutdown before terminating the process.

recovery.description: If true, attempt to recover aborted suites from persisted state on startup.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS for the web UI and secure client connections.

ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL certificate file (required if ssl_enabled is true).

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL private key file (required if ssl_enabled is true).

pidfile.description: Path to PID file for process management.

allowed_clients.description: List of allowed client hostnames/IPs. Empty list allows all hosts.

auto_load_suites.description: List of suite paths (relative to data_dir/suites/) to load automatically at startup.

items.description: Relative path to a suite file (e.g., 'weather/forecast.suite').

smtp_enabled.description: Enable SMTP for sending email notifications (e.g., on suite completion/failure).

smtp_user.description: SMTP username for authentication (leave blank for unauthenticated SMTP).

smtp_pass.description: SMTP password (recommended to use a secure vault or environment variable in production).

smtp_from.description: Sender email address used in notifications.

smtp_tls.description: Enable TLS for SMTP connection (STARTTLS or implicit TLS depending on port).

max_open_files.description: Maximum number of open file descriptors (set to 0 to inherit system ulimit).

max_proc.description: Maximum number of processes (set to 0 to inherit system ulimit).
